title: A Guaranteed Floor and a Promotional Uplift Are Not Both Paid on One Device
content:
Under Northbeam Renew Trade-In a guaranteed floor and a promotional uplift are never paid on the same device, and where both would apply the customer is given whichever leaves them better off. The comparison is made on the amount actually payable: the guaranteed floor against the appraised amount plus the uplift, both worked out before any handling fee is taken off. A membership bonus is not a promotional uplift and may be paid alongside a guaranteed floor, because it rewards the membership rather than the device. Two named promotions are never paid on one device either; the promotion recorded on the agreement when it was opened is the one that pays. Where the customer was told at the till that both would apply, the better of the two is paid and the difference is not made up as goodwill.

**How the bar is judged.** The authority is the agreement's own trade-in history and not the customer's account of what was promised, and it is read before a further uplift is issued. The history is matched to the trade by the agreement reference the rows are held under, and the rows looked at are the uplift rows on that agreement, each told apart by the day it was paid and the promotion it was paid under. Where a promotion is questioned, how often uplifts have already been paid to the profile is taken as the count of uplift rows on every agreement of the profile over the rolling twelve calendar months ending on the day the matter is handled.

**What may and may not stand together on one device.**

| Pair | Both paid |
| --- | --- |
| a guaranteed floor and a promotional uplift | no; the better of the two is paid |
| two named promotions | no; the promotion recorded on the agreement when it was opened pays |
| a guaranteed floor and a membership bonus | yes; the bonus rewards the membership rather than the device |

**The comparison.** It is made on the amount actually payable, which is the guaranteed floor on one side and the appraised amount plus the uplift on the other, each taken before any handling fee is deducted. Where the customer was told at the till that both would apply, the better of the two is still what is paid, and the difference is not made up as goodwill.
